headline: Stock Market Under Pressure, Check 5 Picked Stocks Today
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index eased 0.30% to 5,304.76 as foreign investors net sold Rp440 billion. PT Timah posted a record net profit of Rp4.12 trillion.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index tracks all main-board stocks on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. Foreign flows are closely watched as a gauge of investor sentiment toward the market.
why_moved: Net foreign selling of Rp440 billion weighed on the index, which fell 0.30%.
original_headline: Pasar Saham Tertekan, Simak 5 Saham Pilihan Hari Ini
